to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on

Total number of questions — 15
94
Human trafficking in Jharkhand
†*271. SHRI MAHESH PODDAR:
Will the Minister of HOME  AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that human
trafficking is taking place on a large scale
from the remote forest and tribal areas of
Jharkhand namely, Khunti, Dumka,
Simdega, Gumla, Ranchi, Chaibasa,
Lohardaga and Palamu;
(b) whether it is also a fact that touts
play an important role in well planned
human trafficking;
(c) whether the Central and State
Government have prepared a list of touts
on the basis of intense surveillance; and
(d) if so, by when strict action would
be taken and human trafficking would be
stopped?
Development of Deepor Beel as an Eco
Tourism Hub
*272. SHRI BHUBANESWAR
KALITA: Will the Minister of TOURISM
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Central Government is
aware that the Government of Assam is
making efforts to develop Deepor Beel into
an Eco Tourism Hub;
(b) whether Government is also aware
of the enormous potential for promotion
and development of tourism in Assam;
and
(c) if so, whether the Central
Government would seriously consider
extending all possible help to the
Government of Assam in its endeavour to
develop Deepor Beel into an Eco Tourism
Hub?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

95
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Development of traditional and tribal
sports
*273. SHRI MD. NADIMUL HAQUE:
Will the Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS
AND SPORTS be pleased to state:
(a) what steps have been taken by
Government with regard to travel facilities
in order to facilitate  people to reach the
proposed site of National Sports University
in Manipur, the details thereof;
(b) what steps have been taken by
Government for promotion of traditional
and tribal sports, the details thereof; and
(c) whether Government considers
inclusion of the local and tribal
communities in development of traditional
and tribal sports, respectively, if so, the
steps taken thereon?
Illegal taxi/auto touts at Delhi airport
*274. DR. ANIL KUMAR SAHANI:
Will the Minister of HOME  AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether tourists are being cheated
and fleeced by illegal taxi/auto touts at
domestic and international airport at
Delhi;
(b) the details of such cases reported
during the last three years;
(c) the steps taken by Government for
ensuring safety, security and prevention of
harassment of tourists from touts; and
(d) the progress of deployment of
Tourism Police at all major tourist
destinations in the country?
City Gas Distribution projects in
Karnataka
*275. DR. PRABHAKAR KORE: Will
the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
proposes to take up more City Gas
Distribution (CGD) projects to provide
Piped Natural Gas (PNG) in Karnataka
State;
(b) the number of City Gas Distribution
(CGD) projects presently working and
names of cities identified for
implementation of CGD projects; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Militants storming camps of forces in
J&K
*276. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of HOME  AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that of late
incidents of militants storming the camps
of forces in Jammu and Kashmir have
increased resulting in casualties of the
personnel of such camps;
(b) if so, the details thereof for the last
two years, year-wise; and
(c) what action Government proposes
to take to prevent such incidents in future?
Import restrictions by EU and the US
†*277. SHRI SURENDRA SINGH
NAGAR: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of import ban imposed
by the European Union countries and the
US on Indian products, on the basis of

96
phytosanitary regulations and other
non-tariff restrictions during last three
years;
(b) the total volume of export
opportunities lost by India due to the
above;
(c) whether India is also utilising
phytosanitary regulations and other
non-tariff restrictions to protect the
interests of  Indian consumers and Indian
economy; and
(d) if so, the details of products, the
imports of which have been blocked in
India on the basis of phytosanitary
regulations and other non-tariff restrictions
during the last three years?
Long Term Visa to minorities from
Afghanistan
*278. SHRI ABDUL W AHAB: Will the
Minister of HOME  AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government has decided to
grant Long Term Visa (LTV) to minorities
from Afghanistan seeking refuge in India;
and
(b) if so, the details thereof?

workers in urban areas

Export of special varieties of rice from
Tamil Nadu
2881. DR. V . MAITREYAN: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Central Government has
considered and included the special
varieties of rice cultivated in Tamil Nadu
for export promotion on the lines of
Basmati rice;
(b) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor;
(c) what steps have been taken by
Government to facilitate the export of
special varieties of rice from Tamil Nadu;
and
(d) if so, the action taken thereon?
Survey/study of industrially backward
regions
2882. SHRI P. BHATTACHARY A:
SHRIMATI RAJANI PATIL:
SHRI DARSHAN SINGH
Y ADA V:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has recently
conducted any survey/study of the
industrially backward regions in the
country;
(b) if so, the details thereof, State-wise;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) the steps taken/proposed to be taken
by Government for development of
backward regions in the country?
Reduction of subsidies to farmers
2883. SHRI RAVI PRAKASH
VERMA:
SHRI NEERAJ SHEKHAR:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has agreed
under pressure from the World Trade
Organisation (WTO) to reduce the
subsidies provided by Government to
farmers below 10 pet cent of gross
agricultural production;
677

678
(b) if so, the details thereof and reasons
for compromise with the interest of farmers
and food security of the country; and
(c) if not, the year-wise details of
subsidies provided by Government during
the last three years in percentage of gross
agriculture production?
Investment summits under ‘Make in
India’ initiative
2884. SHRI MAHENDRA SINGH
MAHRA: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of investment summits
held during the years from 2014-15 to
2017-18 under 'Make in India' initiative;
(b) the sector-wise details of MoUs
signed during 2014-15 to 2017-18 through
investment summits under 'Make in India';
(c) the State-wise details of the number
of manufacturing units set up during
2014-15 to 2017-18, how many of these
have been set up as a result of the MoUs
signed, the details thereof;
(d) details of total amount of
investments made by foreign companies
under 'Make in India' during 2014-15 to
2017-18; and
(e) details of labour force participation
rates during 2012-13 to 2017-18?
FDI inflows
2885. SHRI K.K. RAGESH: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the year-wise details of total FDI
inflow of the last four financial years; and
(b) how much of this is long-term
investment?
Impact of GST on India's export
performance
2886. SHRI K.K. RAGESH: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has conducted
any studies to ascertain the impact of GST
on India's export performance;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether any measures have been
taken to address the adverse impacts, if any;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Grant of loan against forged
documents by PEC Limited
2887. DR. K.V.P. RAMACHANDRA
RAO: Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Project
Equipment Corporation (PEC) Ltd. has
granted a huge loan against forged land
documents pledging entire village in Ranga
Reddy district of Telangana, if so, the
details thereof;
(b) what are the primary duties of PEC
and how the PEC is sanctioning huge
amounts of loan without verifying the
authenticity of documents; and
(c) whether Government has any
control over the PEC and how Government
is planning to recover the loan?
Deriving advantages from the impacts
of WTO policies
2888. SHRI MANISH GUPTA: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether India has been able to derive

679
any decisive advantages from the impacts
of the World Trade Organisation (WTO)
policies, if so, the details thereof; and
(b) whether there is any serious conflict
in the WTO between rich and developing
countries in respect of retention of
subsidies and resisting opening of the
markets of the former; if so, the details
thereof?

farming families

(a) whether the World Trade
Organisation (WTO) has any visible
agenda for the resource-poor farming
families;
